chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn Marwan al-Ijli, from Ali ibn Hanzala, who said:
'I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Recognise the statuses of the people upon a measurement of their reporting from us (Our Ahadeeth)'.

key_terms.رِوَايَتِهِمْ: their narrating — the act of transmitting and preserving the Imams' hadith
key_terms.قَدْرِ: measure/degree — the standard or criterion of evaluation
key_terms.مَنَازِلَ: stations/ranks — the spiritual and scholarly standing of persons in the community

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq instruct believers to evaluate the status and rank of people?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes transmission of the Imams' teachings as the primary criterion for evaluating a person's religious standing. The directive implies that the more a person reports and preserves the Ahl al-Bayt's hadith, the higher their rank among the believers.
